constraints: No PTU purchase, reservations, provisioned capacity, model capacity increases, GPUs, VMs, AKS, premium search, or dedicated compute.
Use synthetic unclassified demonstration data only; this is MCAPS testing, not a DND/JDCP deployment or accreditation.
Preserve existing resources, data, model deployments, network settings, and user changes.
New billable Azure infrastructure must be coordinated with the parent agent before creation.

Reuse non-protected existing model endpoints only when the repository documents this configuration and model/region/API compatibility is proven; do not alter them. Do not speculatively retrofit IaC. Use unique ptu-<app>- prefixes for new search indexes and other data objects.

SpecSuite and Planetary Explorer resources are inventory-only: no model calls, new permissions, reuse, reconfiguration, retagging, or redeployment. Protect every resource with these app associations, not only the listed resource groups.

Never print credentials, tokens, keys, connection strings, or save them in source, reports, or OneDrive files. Prefer Azure identity. Runtime environment variables and Azure secret stores are allowed.
Native local servers must bind to 127.0.0.1; public cloud apps require authentication or restricted ingress before exposing paid-model operations.

Small functional tests only; no load tests or bulk ingestion. Maximum 12 live model requests per app agent in this first pass, including retries; request additional allowance from the parent before exceeding this. Retry transient failures with bounded backoff.
Keep processes attached to this session unless the user explicitly requests survival after CLI exit. Record start commands and running process/session IDs.
Record real end-to-end results separately from unit tests, UI-only health checks, compatibility adaptations, and blocked features.
Do not claim actual PTU utilization: existing inventoried deployments are Standard or GlobalStandard, not provisioned SKUs.

The user supplied readable Word documents. Use their extracted text and current official repo docs. The user's explicit parallel-subagent request overrides the playbook's sequential execution suggestion. Record other necessary deviations.

Before deployment record target tenant/subscription, resource group, location, model SKUs, proposed resources and fixed-cost items. Use accelerator-specific resource groups unless explicitly coordinated.
Use tags workload=accelerator-eval owner=parth environment=mcaps-nonprod accelerator=<shortname> protected=false. Never delete Azure resources automatically.
